name: Stoicism
line: Live by reason. Accept what is not up to you.

name: Zen Buddhism
line: Sit, work and eat with full attention.

name: Taoism
line: Move with the way of things, not against it.

name: Vedanta
line: Inquire into the self behind experience.

name: Jungian Individuation
line: Meet your shadow through dreams and symbols.

name: Native American Animism
line: Relate to land, animals and weather as kin.

name: Sufism
line: Seek the divine through love, music and remembrance.

name: Transcendentalism
line: Simplify. Live deliberately, close to nature.
